review_comment: §8.2 states „Random Forest კომპონენტის შიდა ლოგიკა არ ექვემდებარება პირდაპირ ინტერპრეტაციას“, which conflicts with the duty that the model „უნდა იძლეოდეს ახსნისა და ინტერპრეტაციის შესაძლებლობას“. The quote is accurate. The proposal rewrites the regulation's own clause rather than fixing the bank's model (e.g. adding explainability tools such as feature importance), so it does not really remove the conflict.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation turns an NBG-set deadline (min. 6 months) into the bank's own duty to apply 'within an undefined period'; the rationale says the document does not mention NBG consent, but §6.1 does.
review_comment: The regulation says NBG sets the deadline and the bank must meet the requirements and apply for consent; the obligation garbles this. The document does mention consent (§6.1 „ეროვნული ბანკის თანხმობის მიღების შემდეგ“), so 'none' is wrong, but it also states the model is used since 1 June 2021 (§2) with no consent, which is the real issue the gold identifies (art10/p1/sა, income assessment model). The proposal copies the garbled wording.

The regulation requires internal policies to set the approach to missing and outlier data. §4 lists data sources and §5 the model but nothing on missing/outlier treatment, so 'none' is right. Scope is slightly doubtful, since this is a policy duty and the application need only reflect it, but a model application would normally describe data treatment.

The document does address validation: §6.1 says „მოდელის სრული შიდა ვალიდაცია ჩატარდება ეროვნული ბანკის თანხმობის მიღების შემდეგ“ and defers it to 2022, with only developer testing in the meantime. It never says validation covers inputs, calculation and outputs, so the scope gap is real, but 'none' ignores §6.1; 'partial' fits better (arguably a gap in timing, since no validation has been done).

The duty („მატერიალურობის განსაზღვრის პროცესში … გადაწყვეტილების მიღების პროცესზე ზეგავლენა“) governs the bank's internal validation/model-ranking methodology. A supervisory model application is not the document that must set out materiality criteria, so absence there is not a gap.

The materiality criterion „ფინანსურ და საზედამხედველო ანგარიშგებაზე ზეგავლენა“ belongs to the internal model-ranking methodology, not to a per-model application. The proposed 'add_section' in this document misplaces the duty.

„მოდელების ურთიერთდამოკიდებულება“ is one risk-assessment factor in the bank's validation ranking methodology. It is not required content of this application, and the finding turns a list item into a mandatory section.

review_unsupported_claims: Claims the document has no information on expert-judgment replacement; the document does use expert judgement as a benchmark (§9, §10) though not as replacement.
review_comment: The duty is conditional: it applies only if validation results are unsatisfactory and expert judgement replaces results or parameters. The document does not replace outputs with expert judgement (it applies a 0,9 factor in §5.1, which is a model calibration, not an expert replacement), so the condition is arguably not triggered. 'None' is defensible but the conditional nature should have been noted, and the proposal merely restates the regulation.
